## History

Jane Ann was the cousin of Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md). She married a wealthy man whom she did not care for, resulting in an unhappy life.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

## Relationships

### [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--sarah.md)

Jane Ann is the cousin of Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md). During a drive to a boarding house, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) recounts the story of [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ann's unhappy marriage as part of a garrulous conversation regarding her own romantic choices.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), +1 more_

- Relative of — cousin  <sub>[v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)</sub>

### [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--skinner.md)

Jane Ann is the cousin of Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md). Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) brings up Jane Ann while giving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a ride, using [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ann's unhappy marriage as a cautionary contrast to her own decision to marry for love.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), +1 more_
